Option Explicit

Private Function Shown(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    If IsError(v) Then
        Shown = CStr(v)
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Shown = "array"
    Else
        Shown = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Dumped(ByVal n As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, sheet As Object, cell As Object
    For Each sheet In n.Sheets
        s = s & "{" & sheet.Name & " " & sheet.UsedRange.Address & " out=" & sheet.Outline.SummaryRow & "/" & sheet.Outline.SummaryColumn
        For Each cell In sheet.UsedRange.Cells
            If cell.Formula <> "" Or cell.Interior.ColorIndex <> xlNone Then
                s = s & "~" & cell.Address(False, False) & "=" & cell.Formula & ";" & cell.NumberFormat & ";" & cell.Font.Bold & ";" & cell.Font.Color & ";" & cell.Interior.Color & ";" & cell.Interior.ColorIndex & ";" & cell.HorizontalAlignment & ";" & cell.Rows.OutlineLevel & ";" & cell.Borders(xlEdgeBottom).LineStyle & ";" & cell.Borders(xlEdgeTop).LineStyle
            End If
        Next
        s = s & "}"
    Next
    Dumped = s & "active " & ActiveSheet.Name & "!" & ActiveCell.Address(False, False)
End Function

Public Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Object, c As Object, n As Object, ws As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set n = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = n.Worksheets(1)
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path, UpdateLinks:=0, ReadOnly:=True)
    Set c = wb.Connections(1)
    n.Activate
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Run which, wb, c, n, ws, path, r
    s = "ok " & Shown(r)
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Tried = s
    wb.Close False
    n.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function CloseAll(ByVal log As String, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim file As Integer, a As Workbook, b As Workbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set a = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set b = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    a.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 1
    file = FreeFile
    Open log For Append As #file
    Print #file, "before " & Workbooks.Count
    Close #file
    Workbooks.Close
    file = FreeFile
    Open log For Append As #file
    Print #file, "after " & Workbooks.Count
    Close #file
    CloseAll = "returned"
End Function

Private Sub Run(ByVal which As Long, wb As Object, c As Object, n As Object, ws As Object, ByVal path As String, r As Variant)
    Dim x As Object, a As Object, w As Object
    Set w = Application.Workbooks
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.LocaleID
    Case 1
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.MaxDrillthroughRecords
    Case 2
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.OLAP
    Case 3
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.RetrieveInOfficeUILang
    Case 4
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.Refreshing
    Case 5
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.RobustConnect
    Case 6
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.ServerFillColor
    Case 7
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.ServerFontStyle
    Case 8
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.ServerNumberFormat
    Case 9
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.ServerTextColor
    Case 10
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.ServerSSOApplicationID
    Case 11
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.SourceDataFile
    Case 12
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.RefreshDate
    Case 13
        r = TypeName(c.OLEDBConnection.ADOConnection)
    Case 14
        r = TypeName(c.OLEDBConnection.CalculatedMembers)
    Case 15
        c.OLEDBConnection.CancelRefresh
    Case 16
        r = c.OLEDBConnection.CancelRefresh
    Case 17
        c.OLEDBConnection.Reconnect
    Case 18
        c.OLEDBConnection.SaveAsODC "nope"
    Case 19
        c.OLEDBConnection.MakeConnection
    Case 20
        r = TypeName(c.DataFeedConnection)
    Case 21
        r = TypeName(c.Ranges)
    Case 22
        r = c.Ranges.Count
    Case 23
        r = c.Ranges(1).Address
    Case 24
        r = c.Ranges(1).Parent.Name
    Case 25
        r = TypeName(c.ModelTables)
    Case 26
        r = c.ModelTables.Count
    Case 27
        r = c
    Case 28
        r = c.[_Default]
    Case 29
        c.Delete: r = wb.Connections.Count
    Case 30
        c.Delete: r = wb.Queries.Count
    Case 31
        r = c.Delete
    Case 32
        c.Delete: r = wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects.Count & "/" & wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects(1).SourceType
    Case 33
        c.Delete: r = wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value
    Case 34
        r = wb.Queries.FastCombine
    Case 35
        wb.Queries.FastCombine = True: r = wb.Queries.FastCombine
    Case 36
        r = wb.Queries.Count
    Case 37
        For Each x In wb.Queries: r = TypeName(x): Next
    Case 38
        r = wb.Queries.[_Default](1).Name
    Case 39
        r = TypeName(wb.Queries.Item(1))
    Case 40
        For Each x In wb.Connections: r = TypeName(x): Next
    Case 41
        r = wb.Connections.[_Default](1).Name
    Case 42
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): r = TypeName(a) & "/" & n.Connections.Count & "/" & a.Name & "/" & a.Description & "/" & a.Type
    Case 43
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): r = TypeName(a.OLEDBConnection) & "/" & a.OLEDBConnection.Connection & "/" & a.OLEDBConnection.CommandText & "/" & a.OLEDBConnection.CommandType
    Case 44
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): a.Delete: r = n.Connections.Count
    Case 45
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): r = a.Ranges.Count
    Case 46
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): r = a.OLEDBConnection.BackgroundQuery & "/" & a.OLEDBConnection.RefreshOnFileOpen & "/" & a.OLEDBConnection.EnableRefresh & "/" & a.RefreshWithRefreshAll
    Case 47

    Case 48
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): Set a = n.Connections.Add2("mine", "", "OLEDB;Provider=None", "", xlCmdSql): r = a.Name
    Case 49
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("", "", "OLEDB;Provider=None", "", xlCmdSql): r = a.Name
    Case 50
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "", "nonsense", "", xlCmdSql): r = a.Type
    Case 51
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "", "", "", xlCmdSql): r = a.Type
    Case 52
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "", "OLEDB;Provider=None", "", 99): r = a.OLEDBConnection.CommandType
    Case 53
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine"): r = a.Name
    Case 54
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "", "OLEDB;Provider=None"): r = a.OLEDBConnection.CommandType
    Case 55
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2(): r = a.Name
    Case 56
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "", "TEXT;nowhere.csv", "", xlCmdSql): r = a.Type
    Case 57
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "", "ODBC;DSN=nowhere", "", xlCmdSql): r = a.Type
    Case 58
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): a.Refresh
    Case 59
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): r = a.OLEDBConnection.IsConnected
    Case 60
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): a.Name = "Other": r = a.Name & "/" & n.Connections("Other").Name
    Case 61
        Set a = n.Connections.Add2("Mine", "About", "OLEDB;Provider=None;Data Source=nowhere", "Select 1", xlCmdSql): a.Description = "Why": r = a.Description
    Case 62
        r = TypeName(n.Connections.AddFromFile("nope.odc"))
    Case 63
        n.Connections.AddFromFile
    Case 64
        r = TypeName(n.Connections.AddFromFile("nope.odc", True, False))
    Case 65
        r = w.CanCheckOut(path)
    Case 66
        w.CheckOut "nope.xlsx"
    Case 67
        w.CheckOut path
    Case 68
        w.OpenXML "nope.xml"
    Case 69
        w.OpenDatabase "nope.accdb"
    Case 70
        w.OpenXML
    Case 71
        w.OpenDatabase
    Case 72
        ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary
    Case 73
        r = ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary(xlStandardSummary)
    Case 74
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary xlStandardSummary, ws.Range("A2"): r = Dumped(n)
    Case 75
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary: r = Dumped(n)
    Case 76
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary ResultCells:=ws.Range("A2"): r = Dumped(n)
    Case 77
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary 99
    Case 78
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): r = TypeName(ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary(xlStandardSummary, ws.Range("A2")))
    Case 79
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary xlStandardSummary, "x"
    Case 80
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary xlStandardSummary, ws.Range("A2"): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary xlStandardSummary, ws.Range("A2"): r = n.Sheets(1).Name & "/" & n.Sheets(2).Name & "/" & n.Sheets(3).Name & "/" & ActiveSheet.Name
    Case 81
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2": ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5): ws.Scenarios.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"), Array(9): ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary xlPivotTable, ws.Range("A2"): r = Dumped(n)
    Case 82
        ws.Name = "My Data": ws.Range("B2").Value = 1: ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=B2": ws.Names.Add "Input", ws.Range("B2"): n.Names.Add "Result", ws.Range("B3"): ws.Scenarios.Add "One", ws.Range("B2"), Array(5), , , True: ws.Scenarios.CreateSummary xlStandardSummary, ws.Range("B3"): r = Dumped(n)
    End Select
End Sub
